hero_sub: Oasis Women Center is opening a transitional home for women who have finished a recovery program. Every line of the house has a price. Every gift draws it in.

phases.title: The drawing
phases.body: The program is designed, the board is seated, and the house is planned down to the kitchen table.

phases.title: The lease or the purchase
phases.body: A four-bedroom home in Denton County. This is the first line your gift pays for.

phases.title: The rooms made ready
phases.body: Beds, comforters, a lamp and a Bible on every nightstand, and a table big enough for everyone.

phases.title: The door that locks
phases.body: Eight women, twelve to twenty-four months each, in a home that is theirs while they rebuild.

lines.title: An address of her own
lines.body: A job application, a bank account, and a doctor all ask for one. Keisha knows what it is to have none. This line is a month of the lease.
lines.drawing_alt: A pencil and watercolor drawing of a curbside mailbox with flowers at its base.
lines.photo_alt: Looking out through an open front door to a sunlit porch with a white rocking chair and a fern.

lines.title: A door that locks
lines.body: Safety comes first. A lock she can trust, and keys that are hers.
lines.drawing_alt: A pencil and watercolor drawing of a sage green front door with a key in the deadbolt.
lines.photo_alt: House keys, a small notebook and a folded blanket on a sunlit table.

lines.title: A bedroom made ready
lines.body: A comforter, throw pillows, a picture on the wall, and a lamp and a Bible on the nightstand. Four bedrooms, made ready for eight women.
lines.drawing_alt: A pencil and watercolor drawing of a made twin bed beside a nightstand with a lit lamp and a Bible.
lines.photo_alt: A bedroom in bright morning light with a neatly made bed and a lamp and Bible on the nightstand.

lines.title: A window to wake up to
lines.body: Curtains that open, morning light, a plant on the sill. Small things that tell her this is home.
lines.drawing_alt: A pencil and watercolor drawing of a brick window with curtains open and a plant on the sill.
lines.photo_alt: Soft morning light through sheer curtains across a quiet bedroom.

lines.title: The kitchen table
lines.body: Where meals are shared, budgets get written, and nobody eats alone.
lines.drawing_alt: A pencil and watercolor drawing of a wooden kitchen table with two chairs and two mugs.
lines.photo_alt: Two mugs and a small vase on a wooden kitchen table by a window.

lines.title: A ride to work
lines.body: Bus passes, ride share vouchers, and gas cards, so work, court, treatment, and childcare stay within reach.
lines.drawing_alt: A pencil and watercolor drawing of a bus stop sign and a bench under a small tree.
lines.photo_alt: A quiet tree-lined residential street in bright morning daylight.
